problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-10y-5z=10 \\ -10x+100y+50z=-100 \\ -4x+40y+20z=-40\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -10 & -5 & 10 \\ -10 & 100 & 50 & -100 \\ -4 & 40 & 20 & -40\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -10 & -5 & 10 \\ -10 & 100 & 50 & -100 \\ -4 & 40 & 20 & -40\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+10{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -10 & -5 & 10 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 40 & 20 & -40\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -10 & -5 & 10 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
